create_interpolation_pipeline: create a StableDiffusionWalkPipeline for text-to-image generation with interpolation support
run_prompt_interpolation: run slerp interpolation between two text embeddings and noise vectors for smooth image transitions
generate_interpolated_images: generate a sequence of interpolated images by walking through prompts and seeds with slerp noise interpolation
embed_text_for_generation: embed text prompts into CLIP text embeddings for use as conditional inputs in image generation
get_noise_vector: get a reproducible noise vector from a seed for use as latent input in the diffusion pipeline
